title: The Fourth Gallery
html:
Rustpick's air shaft was lined with iron from the cowl to the sump until goblins came up through a crack and took the lining out for scrap. The next storm came down the bare shaft and found the fourth gallery.

About

Given byBettony Crale
Level11
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points3

What you need

  • Shaft Iron ×12

Steps

  1. Talk to Bettony Crale (outdoors near Rustpick Mine) to get the quest.
  2. Take back 12 lengths of shaft iron (12) - Shaft Iron at 109, 178
  3. Kill Ratch inside Rustpick Mine
  4. Report back to Bettony Crale at 109, 178

Some steps in between were not recorded.

Rewards

Reward
Gold350
Character XP16,000
Shock XP279
Quest points3
Choose oneScroll Sparkbolt
or Oak Staff
UnlocksShock magic, Shockbolt

What Bettony Crale says

Bettony Crale: Twelve. That's the eleven they cut out and the one they had started on.

Bettony Crale: It goes back up riveted this time, not bolted, so the next lot has to work for it.

You: And the gallery?

Bettony Crale: Still not a place I would send anybody. Which is the next thing I am going to ask you to do, so I will not pretend otherwise.

Bettony Crale: It went into the cowl about an hour ago. First weather since the iron went back up.

You: I felt it come down the ladder.

Bettony Crale: It went into the cowl because the cowl was there and nothing else was. That's the whole of it. It isn't strength and it isn't aim. It is finished by the time you hear it, and the only question is whether the right thing was standing in the right place beforehand.

Bettony Crale: Rowan and Ide weren't. Come down to the sump and I'll show you what Ide wrote on the pump housing, because he could never keep his hands still either.

Handing it in

"Come down to the sump when you've a minute. Ide wrote something on the pump housing."
